title: Turning IPv6 tunnels into programmable delay lines for pulsing DoS
description: Guest Post: TED shows how permissive tunnel decapsulation and inconsistent IPv6 Extension Header handling can focus low-rate traffic into short, high-rate bursts.

title: PHP Releases Emergency Security Patches as Researchers Report Exploit Attempts
description: PHP has released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities that could enable unauthenticated remote code execution. Security researchers report attempted exploitation, while authorities urge immediate updates across internet-facing hosting environments.

title: Introducing full transaction detection for Cloudflare WAF
description: Cloudflare's web application firewall can now correlate an HTTP request with its response. Full transaction detection helps every customer find successful exploits, data exposure, and risky misconfigurations that request-only inspection can miss.

title: Cloudflare deploys protections against php2shell vulnerability
description: Cloudflare has deployed default web application firewall (WAF) protections for newly disclosed PHP vulnerabilities before public disclosure. The rules use request and response signals to stop exploit attempts and prevent exposed data from reaching attackers.

title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents

title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
